# Uses of the array syntax

*Generated by `tools/array-syntax-uses.py`; do not edit.*

SPARQL-array reaches into a sequence with **gaps** `...` and `...?rest` in a sequence pattern, with `UNNEST(expr AS ?x AT ?i)`, and with the functions `isSEQ`, `SEQLEN`, `SEQ`, `expr[i]`, `expr[m...n]` and `IN ?seq`; ShEx-array constrains one with the **LIST shape expression** `LIST ( regex )` and `LIST card x` ([array-syntax.md](../docs/array-syntax.md), which replaced the first proposal `((x))[i]` and `((shapeExpr))[m, n]`). These are the files a change of syntax has to rewrite; the tests that use the SPARQL forms also say so with `mf:requires ra:GapPatterns`, `ra:Unnest` or `ra:SequenceFunctions`, and the ShEx ones with `ra:ListShapeExpression`.
